purpose: Discover model and dataset candidates with checkpoint, license, and lineage states via offline fixture or replay pages.
inclusion: Public model or dataset registry records with durable identifiers
Checkpoint hash, license statement, and lineage fields when present
exclusion: Inferring clinical benefit, regulatory authorization, or deployment readiness from a model card
Treating a model family name as an exact-system identity
Live HTTP inside the discovery package

identity_key.name: model_or_dataset_id
identity_key.match_rule: Exact model or dataset identifier including namespace. Version tags are distinct identities unless an explicit successor disposition is recorded.

denominator_policy: Caller-supplied result-set size is a raw denominator. It is not model-universe completeness.
pagination_policy: Terminal pagination must be explicit. Cursor completion is not recall.
known_identity_reconciliation: Optional model/dataset id to source_id map. Exact matches emit DUPLICATE.
cadence: Human-gated. Offline fixture/replay only in this programme maturity.
raw_input_boundary: Caller supplies already-retrieved model/dataset payloads. Discovery has no embedded live HTTP client.
human_review_path: Candidate proposals remain PENDING_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE until adjudicate_candidate_source.

evaluation.precision_method: Sampled human review of NEW candidates (not executed by this software).

boundary: SU-MODEL offline programme execution emits candidates and coverage. A model or dataset listing is not an exact-system assessment and does not grant release authority.
